media_source.title: Add recordings
media_source.description: Where are the videos and photos of your flights stored? They are linked to a flight when their recording time overlaps the flight.

local.title: Folder with recordings
local.description:
A folder Home Assistant can read. Subfolders are read as well.

**NAS (SMB/CIFS or NFS):** first add the share under Settings → System → Storage → *Add network storage* with usage **Media**. It then appears as `/media/<name>`.

Thumbnails are made with ffmpeg; recordings play in the browser through Home Assistant.

user.title: DJI Flight Log
user.description: Folder that receives the DJI Fly flight records (*.txt). Newer logs (v13+) are encrypted; a free DJI Developer API key is needed to decode the GPS track and telemetry. Without it only the header data (time, duration, distance, max height) is imported.

data.geo_location_limit: Flights exposed as geo_location entities (0 = none; any of them makes Home Assistant add a map to the auto-generated Overview dashboard)

onedrive_folder.title: OneDrive folder with recordings
onedrive_folder.description:
Signed in as {account}. Current folder: **{path}**{notice}

Click a subfolder to open it, go up one level or use the current folder. Subfolders are read as well. Recordings are linked to a flight when their recording time overlaps the flight.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to OneDrive again
reauth_confirm.description: The OneDrive sign-in expired or was revoked. Sign in again to keep linking recordings.

abort.wrong_account: Signed in with a different Microsoft account than before
abort.missing_credentials: Add the application credentials of your Azure app first
abort.missing_configuration: OneDrive is not configured; add application credentials first
abort.no_url_available: No URL available; check your Home Assistant external/internal URL
abort.oauth_failed: Error while obtaining the access token
abort.oauth_unauthorized: OAuth authorization error while obtaining the access token

data.geo_location_limit: Flights exposed as geo_location entities (0 = none; any of them makes Home Assistant add a map to the auto-generated Overview dashboard)

folder.title: OneDrive folder with recordings
folder.description:
Current folder: **{path}**{notice}

Click a subfolder to open it, go up one level or use the current folder. Subfolders are read as well.

local.title: Folder with recordings
local.description: A folder Home Assistant can read, e.g. network storage under `/media/<name>`. Subfolders are read as well.

scan.name: Scan log folder
scan.description: Scan the log folder now instead of waiting for the next interval.

import_file.name: Import file
import_file.description: Import a single DJI Fly flight record.

path.name: Path
path.description: Absolute path of the .txt log file.

export_track.name: Export track
export_track.description: Export a flight track as GPX, KML or GeoJSON. Without a path the content is returned in the response.

flight_id.name: Flight ID
flight_id.description: Flight id or 'last' for the most recent flight.

path.name: Path
path.description: File or folder to write to (must be in allowlist_external_dirs).

application_credentials.description: Recordings are read from OneDrive through Microsoft Graph. Register an app at the [Microsoft Entra portal]({portal_url}): supported account types "personal Microsoft accounts" (or any, for OneDrive for Business), platform **Web** with redirect URI `{redirect_url}`, then create a client secret. Delegated permissions: Files.Read, offline_access.
